story.description:
User Story
Story ID: KAN-11
Epic: Travel & Hospitality
Feature: Hotels Management
Module: Hotels
Priority: High
Story Points: 13
Type: Story
Title
Search, Filter, View, and Book Hotels through the Hotels Module
Description
As a customer,
I want to search hotels based on destination, travel dates, guests, rooms, price, rating, amenities, and other filters,
So that I can discover available accommodations, compare options, view hotel details, and complete a hotel reservation successfully. The Hotels module allows users to browse accommodations, apply multiple filters, inspect hotel details, and proceed toward booking.
Business Objective
Provide users with an intuitive hotel discovery and booking experience while ensuring:
Accurate hotel availability
Correct pricing
Reliable filtering
Responsive search
Secure booking flow
Consistent user experience across desktop and mobile
Actors
Primary Actor
Customer
Secondary Actors
Authenticated User
Guest User
Hotel Provider
Booking Service
Payment Gateway
Notification Service
Preconditions
User has internet connectivity.
Hotels page is accessible.
Hotel inventory is available.
Hotel search service is operational.
User can be either authenticated or guest.
Booking service is available.
Trigger
User opens the Hotels page from the navigation menu.
Main Flow
User opens Hotels page.
User selects destination.
User selects check-in date.
User selects check-out date.
User selects guests.
User selects rooms.
User clicks Search.
System retrieves available hotels.
User applies filters.
User sorts hotels.
User opens hotel details.
User reviews:
Images
Amenities
Policies
Ratings
Reviews
Room options
User selects room.
User proceeds to booking.
User reviews booking summary.
User confirms booking.
System creates reservation.
Booking confirmation is displayed.
Confirmation notification is sent.
Alternate Flows
AF-01
No hotels found
System displays an informative empty state with suggestions.
AF-02
Destination unavailable
User receives a validation message.
AF-03
Selected dates unavailable
System requests alternative dates.
AF-04
Hotel becomes unavailable
Booking is blocked with an availability message.
AF-05
Price changes
System asks user to accept the updated price before continuing.
AF-06
Session expires
User is prompted to sign in again.
AF-07
Guest booking
User completes booking without logging in (if supported).
Exception Flows
Search API unavailable
Booking API failure
Payment timeout
Invalid hotel ID
Invalid room selection
Inventory mismatch
Duplicate booking attempt
Network interruption
Browser refresh during booking
Payment declined
Business Rules
BR-01
Destination is mandatory.
BR-02
Check-out date must be after check-in date.
BR-03
Guests cannot exceed room occupancy.
BR-04
Rooms must have available inventory.
BR-05
Only available hotels are displayed.
BR-06
Sorting must not modify filter selection.
BR-07
Filters remain active after pagination.
BR-08
Hotel pricing must match booking summary.
BR-09
Booking cannot continue after hotel becomes unavailable.
BR-10
Confirmation is generated only after successful booking.
Acceptance Criteria
AC-01
Given the Hotels page is opened
When the page loads
Then search controls are displayed.
AC-02
Given valid search criteria
When Search is clicked
Then matching hotels are displayed.
AC-03
Given no hotels match
When Search completes
Then an empty state is displayed.
AC-04
Given filters are applied
When filter selection changes
Then only matching hotels remain visible.
AC-05
Given sorting is selected
When results refresh
Then hotel order updates without changing applied filters.
AC-06
Given a hotel is selected
When hotel details open
Then hotel information is displayed correctly.
AC-07
Given room selection
When Continue Booking is clicked
Then booking summary is shown.
AC-08
Given successful booking
When payment completes
Then confirmation page is displayed.
AC-09
Given booking failure
When reservation cannot be completed
Then an appropriate error message is displayed.
AC-10
Given network interruption
When retry succeeds
Then booking continues without data loss.
Non-Functional Requirements
Performance
Search response <3 seconds
Filter update <2 seconds
Hotel details load <3 seconds
Booking confirmation <5 seconds
Accessibility
WCAG 2.1 AA
Keyboard navigation
Screen reader support
Visible focus indicators
ARIA labels
Security
Authentication
Authorization
CSRF protection
XSS protection
SQL injection prevention
Secure payment flow
Session timeout handling
Compatibility
Chrome
Firefox
Safari
Edge
Mobile browsers
Tablet browsers
Reliability
Retry transient failures
Graceful handling of service outages
Consistent booking state
API Integrations
Hotel Search API
Hotel Details API
Availability API
Pricing API
Booking API
Payment API
Notification API
Test Coverage Expectations
Your AI generator should derive tests for:
Search
Destination selection
Date validation
Guest and room validation
Hotel availability
Filters
Sorting
Pagination
Hotel details
Room selection
Booking
Confirmation
Cancellation
Negative scenarios
Edge cases
Accessibility
Security
API validation
Error handling
Recovery
Responsive UI
Cross-browser compatibility
Performance
End-to-end booking workflow
